chunks: There will be groaning for them, and they will not hear.

key_terms.زَفِيرٌ: A deep groan or sigh of despair

ai.seo_question: What is the nature of the sound made by those in Hell according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the absolute finality of divine judgment, where the 'zafir' (deep groan) signifies the internalization of regret that no external mercy can alleviate. It underscores the concept of 'ghurrah' (deception) where the disbelievers realize their folly too late, cut off from the intercession of the Ahl al-Bayt or angels. This state reflects the severance of the soul from divine grace, emphasizing that their deafness is both physical and spiritual due to their prior rejection of truth.
